name: RunDueAutomations
description: Hourly check (MailAutomationsRunner workflow → MailAutomationsPipeline). For each active MailAutomations row: due when, in Asia/Jerusalem, today's day of month >= dayOfMonth and the current hour >= hour, and no MailAutomationRuns row with trigger מתוזמן and status הושלמה exists for it this month (a day past the end of a short month counts as the last day). Each due automation runs through the RunMailAutomation logic with dryRun=false, trigger מתוזמן, requestedBy 'ריצה מתוזמנת'. A failed run is recorded with status נכשלה and does not stop the others. Sends nothing.

now.description: ISO time to evaluate against; default now
